findings.message: The usecase catalogue references `PrCommandOutput` and `SignalCommandOutput` in `PrCommandPort.execute` and `SignalCommandPort.execute`, but neither output type is declared in any of the six in-scope catalogues. This leaves the secondary-port contract without a declared return type/shape and omits the post-change public types that the drivers and adapters consume.

`PrCommandPort::execute` performs filesystem, Git/GitHub, terminal, and polling I/O through `SystemPrCommandAdapter`, but is declared synchronous and the entry docs do not acknowledge an intentional blocking/synchronous CLI boundary. Document that choice or make the port async to avoid adapter-level color rework.

`SignalCommandPort::execute` covers filesystem, Git, rustdoc, and gate I/O through `SystemSignalCommandAdapter`, but is declared synchronous without docs establishing that blocking execution is intentional. Document the synchronous CLI model or expose an async contract.

`usecase::PrCommandPort` の docs は同期境界の選択を記録する範囲を越え、CN-01 の「既存の command sequencing と observable behavior を維持する」という上流の挙動・理由を散文で再記述しています。同期・blocking の型ローカルな選択だけを残し、上流契約は既存の `spec_refs` の CN-01 参照に委ねてください。
`usecase::SignalCommandPort` の docs も、CN-01 の挙動維持契約と migration scope を散文で再説明しています。`no-upstream-restatement.md` に従い、同期・blocking を意図した port であることだけを記録し、挙動契約は `spec_refs` の CN-01 参照に集約してください。
`plan.summary[0]` restates the upstream dependency-order rationale instead of limiting the plan section to target, operation, and anchor cites.
`T001` includes the upstream behavioral/rationale restatement “while retaining the current live PR path”; keep the executable target/operation and anchor cites, but remove the restatement.
`T002` includes the upstream behavioral/rationale restatement “while retaining the current live Signal path”; keep the executable target/operation and anchor cites, but remove the restatement.
`T003` includes the upstream cutover-order rationale “without switching composition yet”; keep the executable target/operation and anchor cites, but remove the restatement.
`T004` includes the upstream cutover-order rationale “without switching composition yet”; keep the executable target/operation and anchor cites, but remove the restatement.
`T005` restates the upstream self-hosting/observable-behavior contract (“proving the self-hosted ... paths remain operational”); retain only the target, operation, and anchor cites.

`T006` restates the upstream compatibility and self-hosting contract (“retaining their compatibility definitions” and “prove the self-hosted ... path remains operational”); retain only the target, operation, and anchor cites.
`T007` restates upstream contract behavior (“arguments, stdout, stderr, exit code, and persistence” and live-reference requirements); retain only the target, operation, and anchor cites.

The section descriptions `pr-typed-boundary`, `signal-typed-boundary`, `pr-cutover`, `signal-cutover`, and `contract-evidence-and-surface-cleanup` restate upstream design rationale and behavior in prose. They should contain only the section target/operation and anchor cites.

Task descriptions T001 and T002 restate the upstream live-path behavior contract (“retaining the current live PR/Signal path”). Remove that rationale while retaining target, operation, and anchor cites.
Task descriptions T003 and T004 restate the upstream cutover-order rationale (“without switching composition yet”). Remove that rationale while retaining target, operation, and anchor cites.

Task descriptions T005 and T006 restate upstream behavior and self-hosting contracts (“proving/prove the self-hosted ... paths remain operational” and compatibility retention). Remove those restatements while retaining target, operation, and anchor cites.

Task T007 and the plan section `contract-evidence-and-surface-cleanup` restate the upstream CLI contract and live-reference requirements in prose. Keep the executable test/removal operations and anchor cites, but remove the behavior-contract restatement.

Plan summary item 1 and the section descriptions `pr-typed-boundary`, `signal-typed-boundary`, `pr-cutover`, and `signal-cutover` restate upstream design rationale and dependency behavior. Plan sections should contain only target, operation, and anchor cites.

T001's task description claims adding `PrCommand` and validated PR value objects, but `task-contract.json` also attributes `usecase/PrCommandOutput`, which is not described as added or modified. Add the output type to the task description or move its attribution.

T002's task description claims adding `SignalCommand` and `SignalCommandInteractor`, but `task-contract.json` also attributes `usecase/SignalCommandOutput`, which is not described as added or modified. Add the output type to the task description or move its attribution.

T001 says to add `PrCommandOutput` and `PrCommandInteractor`, but its attributed catalogue entries mark them as `reference` and `modify`, respectively; both symbols already exist. Keep the reference attribution, but change T001 and section `pr-typed-boundary` to reuse `PrCommandOutput` and modify the existing interactor rather than creating them.

T002 says to add `SignalCommandOutput`, although its attributed catalogue entry is `action: reference` and the symbol already exists. Keep the carrier attribution but make the task explicitly reuse/reference this output type.

T007 explicitly removes three `cli-composition` re-exports, but OUT-02 reserves physical deletion of exports for the Final convergence track; citing OUT-02 does not authorize the excluded work. Remove this deletion step from T007 and section `contract-evidence-and-surface-cleanup`.

`plan.summary` only mentions T001–T007 and provides no GO-01 or GO-02 mappings. Because goals cannot be represented in `task-coverage.json`, this field is the sole goal-to-task traceability record and must explicitly map both goals to their carrier tasks.

AC-07 maps only to T006, whose description contains wiring and removal work but no validation step. T007 owns the Signal CLI integration and live-reference evidence yet is not mapped to AC-07, leaving this acceptance criterion without credible validation coverage. Add explicit AC-07 validation to T006 or map an appropriate validation step in T007.

T007 identifies only work kinds—“PR and Signal CLI integration tests” and “a live-reference check”—without naming a target file or symbol. Because T007 intentionally has no catalogue attribution and multiple CLI test surfaces exist, the executor must invent the placement and boundary. Specify the exact test/check paths or symbols while retaining the anchor cites.

T007 and section `contract-evidence-and-surface-cleanup` restate OUT-02 in prose with “leave physical compatibility-surface deletion to the Final convergence track.” Under `knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md`, retain the OUT-02 anchor and remove this repeated upstream contract clause.

GO-01 is not fully covered: AC-03 verifies the driver → usecase interactor → port pure-DI path only for PR, while no acceptance criterion deterministically verifies the equivalent Signal execution path. AC-02 and AC-04 only constrain the Signal composition root and legacy references, so a Signal path that still bypasses the intended typed DI route could satisfy all current ACs.
findings.category: missing AC coverage for a stated goal
